readiness.reason: Cell A2T-AA four-row smoke -- the Audio2Tool carrier's own request-identical null on the paired 400 (owner decisions 67, 68, 71 and 139; measurement instrument rules 3 and 6), registered before contact on 2026-09-27 by script from the sealed direct baseline's own fragments (decision 58). HELD: root mints coordination/a2t-stage3-aa-paired-400-v1/root-admission-v1.json (decision id a2t-stage3-aa-paired-400-admission-v1) naming the six eligible run ids and this package's caps, then flips the smoke, pass A and pass B with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py --set-ready through scripts/flights/batch/a2taa_flip_all.sh. The program declares no supplied first phase (item E38), so the re-pin creates no prepared artifact and no preparation requirement; the requirements list is empty by design and --allow-output-change is never passed. The chain flies only on the Audio2Tool session serving-a2t-native-role-base-np3-max2048-v3 (c98304 np3 x 32,768 max2048, the A2T packet root), never on the resident SLURP np4 session. Nothing here authorises a flight, a readiness flip or an admission entry.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. A failure in the smoke stops the chain and pass A does not open; a failure in pass A stops the chain and pass B does not open. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new live_phase_fit run and attempt id (a journaled fit cannot be retried under a spent fit identity); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): an INFRASTRUCTURE abort with code and request bytes unchanged takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly under fresh identities. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. If pass A and pass B do not seal on ONE resident session, the pair is not request-identical and the null is not read from it.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program (configs/policy/phase-direct-only-v1.json: one phase, max_contacts 1, always-run-full-program) makes exactly ONE contact per row, so 4 x 1 = 4 is the program's exact maximum and its expectation at once; the sealed direct baseline realised 4,000 contacts on 4,000 rows. The live phase fit makes 1 + (2 + 1) x 4 = 13 tokenizer endpoint calls under its own run id SAEA-A2T-STAGE3-AA-PAIRED-400-SMOKE-4-FIT-V1 -- the count core.preparation_fit.complete_phase_endpoint_count requires to the unit; the fit gate refuses any other cap. At the sealed direct baseline's own realised rate (4,000 contacts in 1,518.6 s of generation wall at np3) the generation wall is about 2 s; the GPU-hour ceiling of 0.2 covers fit, packet validation and client initialisation many times over and is a BOUND, never a target. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.
